name: Efficient Quiver

source.note: Entered from knowledge of the 2024 DMG (personal build); check every number against the book.

summary: Holds 60 arrows, 18 javelins and 6 bows or staffs, and always weighs 2 lb.
text: Three compartments, each opening onto an extradimensional space, let this quiver carry far more than it should while never topping 2 pounds. The short compartment takes up to 60 arrows, bolts or similar ammunition; the middle one fits up to 18 javelins or the like; the long one stores up to 6 lengthy items like spears, quarterstaffs or bows. Pulling anything out works just like drawing from an ordinary quiver or scabbard.
